theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $f_L,f_R:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, original lengths $N_L,N_R$, positive band size $g$, arithmetic modulus $p$, signed shift $\delta$, parameters $h,J$ and cutoff $c\le W=J\cdot464h$ be given. Suppose memory stores the exact paired original-source bucket catalog and the complete occurrence array, selected cover maps, candidate indices and bucket counts. All retained data end before bank base $b$, and occurrence rows agree with the representative of every source occurrence code. Assume addresses fit words, the complete packed bank through all independent band slices fits memory, its step word bound fits and depth $d+W+13$ is allowed. With the literal batch closure present, the program constructs

$$\operatorname{At}(\nu,f_L,f_R,b,N_L,N_R,g,h,J,c,p,\delta,i)\quad\text{for every valid band-pair slice }i,$$

within its prescribed full-batch time, preserving every cell below $b$.

This realizes the full reusable source-bank collection across independent B/C band choices.
